mapper.select: SELECT id FROM sys_user WHERE id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM export_task WHERE requested_by = #{userId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM export_task WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING')

SELECT a.id, COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(title_override.field_value), a.title_original, a.title_normalized) AS title, a.doi_normalized AS doi, COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(type_override.field_value), a.achievement_type) AS achievement_type, COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(language_override.field_value), a.language) AS language, COALESCE( STR_TO_DATE(JSON_UNQUOTE(date_override.field_value), '%Y-%m-%d'), a.publication_date) AS publication_date, canonical_venue.display_name AS primary_venue
ORDER BY a.id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO export_task ( id, format, status, filters_json, requested_by, requested_count, exported_count, download_token, created_at, version ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{format}, #{status}, CAST(#{filtersJson} AS JSON), #{requestedBy}, #{requestedCount}, #{exportedCount}, #{downloadToken}, #{createdAt}, 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT id, format, status, CAST(filters_json AS CHAR) AS filters_json, requested_by, requested_count, exported_count, download_token, file_name, file_relative_path, created_at, started_at, completed_at, expires_at, error_code, error_message, version FROM export_task WHERE id = #{taskId}
mapper.update: UPDATE export_task SET status = 'RUNNING', started_at = #{startedAt}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{taskId} AND status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE export_task SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', exported_count = #{exportedCount}, file_name = #{fileName}, file_relative_path = #{fileRelativePath}, completed_at = #{completedAt}, expires_at = #{expiresAt}, error_code = NULL, error_message = NULL, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{taskId} AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE export_task SET status = 'FAILED', completed_at = #{completedAt}, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{taskId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING')
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM export_task WHERE status = 'RUNNING' ORDER BY started_at, id
